verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents a public REST API with per-endpoint reference pages (customers, monitoring, cases, audit, exports, transactions). It also provides API credential management, rate-limit headers, a versioning policy, a Postman collection and a downloadable OpenAPI schema, which a probe retrieved and parsed as OpenAPI 3.0.3. The 404s at the generic openapi.json paths do not contradict this, because the schema was found at its documented location. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent corroboration of authenticated API operations (the probe only retrieved documentation).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
